## README.md
> **This dataset has moved.** It is now published, updated and extended as [Latvia Lauki Parcels](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/lv) in the [Harmonized Field Boundary Data](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data) catalog. The files here are no longer updated.

# Field boundaries for Latvia

Provides 420863 official field boundaries from Latvia.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from Rural Support 
Survice Republic of Latvia (Lauku atbalsta dienests).

- **Source Data Provider:** [Rural Support Survice Republic of Latvia (Lauku atbalsta dienests)](https://www.lad.gov.lv/lv/lauku-registra-dati)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **License:** CC-BY-SA-4.0
- **Projection:** EPSG:3059

---

- [Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/latvia/latvia.parquet)
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/latvia/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/latvia/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/latvia/latvia.pmtiles)

## Columns

| Property               | **Data Type** | Description |
|------------------------|---------------|-------------|
| id                     | string        |             |
| parcel_id              | uint64        |             |
| determination_datetime | timestamp     |             |
| area                   | float         |             |
| crop:code_list         | string        |             |
| crop:code              | string        |             |
| crop:name              | string        |             |
| crop:name_en           | string        |             |

## Lineage

- Data downloaded on 2024-12-03 from https://karte.lad.gov.lv/arcgis/services/lauki/MapServer/WFSServer .
- Converted to GeoParquet using [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli), version 0.8.0
